Thanks for using our pack!

Please import the package relating to your selected render pipeline to get the correct shaders. The demo scene is mainly lit for HDRP but will still render in the other packages.

If you have any problems please reach out to us at lottellustudio@gmail.com or our Discord https://discord.gg/m6sV3MyM

If you like this pack we'd really appreciate a review! It helps us make more. :)

Thanks again and happy developing!
